channel.title: Prod2 — Kitchen notes & buying guides
channel.description: What to compare before you buy. Question-shaped kitchen buying guides with every figure sourced.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what to compare
item.description: Basket-style or oven-style? Compare the right things: footprint, food shape, capacity zones, cleanup. With the listed values for each format, sourced.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for air-fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts, litres and basket counts don't compare themselves. A five-minute checklist for comparing air-fryer capacity honestly, with listed values.

item.title: Cleanup and counter-space trade-offs, assessed
item.description: What listed dimensions, materials and dishwasher-safe parts say about cleanup and counter space — and how to weigh the trade-off before buying.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying multi-function gear
item.description: Air fry, bake, dehydrate, rotisserie: which functions will you actually use? The questions that separate a worktop workhorse from a cupboard-filler.

item.title: How accurate does a meat thermometer need to be?
item.description: ±0.5°F vs ±1°F, instant-read vs leave-in wireless: what accuracy claims on the listing mean and which thermometer fits which cook.

item.title: Buying guide: choose by format, capacity and counter fit
item.description: A buying guide that starts from your kitchen, not a brand: format first, then capacity, then counter depth, then cleanup — with the questions that decide each.
